Very good track, but why would army, navy, and air force command centres be novel for the Indian military? But it does involve all three
Are these the locations of upcoming theatre commands

These are the HQs of India's theatre commands. Lucknow is for the Northern Command, Jaipur is for the Western Command, Thiruvananthapuram is for the Maritime Command, and Port Blair is for the A&N Command
